title: Keep Engram's refusal of an acceptance submission on the evaluator delegation and name its class in the result summary
outcome: When Engram refuses an acceptance evaluator's submission (a void such as "source changed after evidence basis N", a resubmit such as "a host check was recorded after evidence basis N", or another refusal), termal_list_delegations shows no acceptanceEvaluation.submission for that delegation, and its result summary says only "refused". The 409 text survives only in the child's free-text Findings, readable through termal_get_session_result. So a parent or coordinator that counts or triages evaluator failures from delegation records sees unexplained refusals. Wanted: keep the last refusal on acceptanceEvaluation.submission as {state: refused, httpStatus, engramCode, class (resubmit | void | other), message, at}, and name the class in the result summary.
acceptance: Keep Engram's refusal of an acceptance submission on the evaluator delegation and name its class in the result summary is done
